description: Simulated experiments on BP930 satellite batteries using the MACCOR system. Designed for battery performance characterisation in small satellite mission profiles.
notes: Imported from README; verify data access, license, chemistry, and labels at source.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: NASA's repository page names the BP930 batteries but not their chemistry.

name: Accelerated Battery Life Testing (NASA)
source: University of Central Florida, hosted by NASA PCoE
description: Accelerated lifecycle data for 18650-cell Li-ion packs under constant, random loading, and second-life conditions.
notes: Imported from README; verify data access, license, chemistry, and labels at source.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the NASA page describes two-cell 18650 packs but not the cell model or chemistry.

name: MagBridge-Battery v1.0
description: Synthetic bridge dataset for lithium-ion battery magnetometry and state-of-health diagnostics. Contains 6,760 samples for SOH regression, second-life classification and anomaly detection. Not direct experimental magnetometry measurements.

chemistry_evidence.note: Zenodo record: LFP cells; magnetometry signatures conditioned on PulseBat state-of-health labels.

name: CALCE Battery Data (University of Maryland)
scale: 6 cell types · 15 CS2, 12 CX2 and 16 pouch cells cycled · 144 cells in storage tests
description: Long-running collection from the CALCE battery group: cycle ageing of prismatic LCO cells (CS2, CX2) and pouch cells under different currents and state-of-charge windows, dynamic drive-profile tests (DST, FUDS, US06) on NMC and LFP cylindrical cells at several temperatures, and storage tests with periodic capacity and impedance checks.
notes: No licence stated; the page asks users to cite the CALCE papers that describe each test. Each cell type has its own reference papers.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data page: CS2, CX2 and pouch cells have LiCoO2 cathodes; INR 18650-20R is NMC/graphite; A123 cells are LiFePO4.

name: Oxford Battery Degradation Dataset 1
description: Long-term ageing of eight small Kokam pouch cells in a 40 °C chamber: constant-current constant-voltage charging and discharge with the urban Artemis drive cycle, with characterisation tests every 100 cycles.
notes: The record links Christoph Birkl's PhD thesis rather than a journal paper. Test details are in the readme.

chemistry_evidence.note: The Oxford data record only says lithium-ion; Battery Archive, which hosts a copy, lists the cells as LCO.

name: Oxford Path-Dependent Battery Degradation Dataset
description: Studies whether the order and spacing of cycling and calendar rest change how cells age. Four groups of three cells alternate days of cycling with days of rest at two currents; includes reference performance tests, impedance spectra and half-cell data.
notes: About 3 GB of .mat files with a data guide.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record: commercial 18650 cells with NCA positive and graphite negative electrodes.

name: Sandia Commercial Cell Degradation Dataset (SNL)
scale: Commercial 18650 cells of three chemistries · several temperatures, depths of discharge and currents
description: Commercial LFP, NCA and NMC 18650 cells cycled to 80% capacity while varying temperature, depth of discharge and discharge current, with regular capacity checks. One of the most used multi-chemistry ageing sets; hosted on Battery Archive.
notes: Full CSV files are available from Battery Archive; the site asks users to email for complete study files.

chemistry_evidence.note: Battery Archive study summary: NCA, NMC and LFP 18650 cells.

name: HNEI Cell-to-Cell Variability Dataset (LG ICR18650 C2)
scale: 15 cells from one batch · over 1,000 cycles each
description: A batch of commercial 2.8 Ah laptop cells cycled under identical conditions (1.5C discharge, 25 °C) to measure how much ageing varies between nominally identical cells, with slow reference tests every 100 cycles.
notes: Hosted on Battery Archive.

chemistry_evidence.note: Paper: graphite negative electrode; positive electrode is a blend of LiCoO2 and NMC.

name: Closed-Loop Fast-Charging Optimisation Dataset
source: Stanford, MIT and Toyota Research Institute
scale: A123 18650 cells · 224 six-step fast-charging protocols explored
description: Cells charged with ten-minute, six-step fast-charging protocols chosen by Bayesian optimisation and early life prediction, plus a validation set run to end of life. Hosted on the same portal as the Severson et al. cycle-life data.

chemistry_evidence.note: The paper names A123 18650M1A cells but not the chemistry; the companion Severson et al. study describes the same cell type as LFP/graphite.

name: eVTOL Battery Dataset (Carnegie Mellon)
description: Cells cycled with simulated electric-aircraft missions (high-power take-off, cruise, high-power landing), changing one factor at a time: power, duration, charge current, charge voltage or temperature. Capacity and resistance checks every 50 cycles.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the data descriptor names the Sony-Murata VTC6 cell but not its chemistry.

name: EVBattery: Large-Scale EV Charging Dataset
scale: 464 EVs from 3 makers · over 1.2 million charging snippets
description: Charging records from hundreds of electric vehicles in service, cut into fixed-length snippets of 128 time steps, for estimating capacity and health from real charging data.
notes: The paper links the data and code from a OneDrive folder.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the paper does not state the battery chemistry of the vehicles.

name: Battery Magnetometry Data 2019–2020 (OSF)
scale: 1 pouch cell · 5 voltage states · 41 scan positions each
description: Sensitive atomic-magnetometer maps of the weak magnetic field around a lithium-ion pouch cell at several states of charge. The fields reflect how charge is stored inside the cell. Basis for the real magnetic signatures in MagBridge-Battery.
notes: The OSF page could not be read automatically; details come from the PNAS study and the MagBridge-Battery paper, which uses this archive.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the paper names a Powerstream pouch cell and reports a cobalt-rich cathode by X-ray analysis, but gives no chemistry label.

name: LG 18650HG2 Li-ion Battery Data (McMaster)
scale: New 3 Ah LG HG2 cell · drive cycles at several temperatures
description: Lab tests of an LG HG2 cell under drive cycles in a thermal chamber, released with an example deep neural network state-of-charge estimator in MATLAB. Widely used for SOC estimation benchmarks.
notes: Licence field is blank on the data page.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the data record says Li-ion only.

name: Panasonic 18650PF Li-ion Battery Data
source: University of Wisconsin-Madison and McMaster University
scale: New 2.9 Ah cell · HPPC, drive cycles and EIS at 5 temperatures
description: Pulse, drive-cycle and impedance tests on a Panasonic 18650PF cell across five temperatures. One of the standard sets for neural-network SOC estimation since the LSTM study of Chemali et al.
notes: Licence field is blank on the data page.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the data record says lithium-ion only.

name: UNIBO Powertools Dataset
source: University of Bologna and industry partner
scale: 27 cells from several makers · cycled to end of life
description: Cells for floor-cleaning machines and vacuum cleaners cycled to end of life under standard, high-current and pre-conditioned (90 days at 45 °C) tests, with capacity checks every 100 cycles.
notes: A Python loader is on GitHub. Licence field is blank on the data page.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the data record does not give cell models or chemistry.

name: Michigan Battery Expansion Dataset
scale: 31 cells made in-house · wide range of stress factors
description: Cells built at the UM Battery Lab, aged at different temperatures, depths of discharge and currents while their swelling is measured, to use expansion as an ageing signal.
notes: Hosted on Battery Archive.

chemistry_evidence.note: Battery Archive study summary: graphite negative and NMC111 positive electrodes.

name: Michigan Formation Protocol Dataset
scale: 40 cells · fast vs baseline formation · 25 °C and 45 °C
description: Half of the cells went through fast formation and half through baseline formation, then all were cycled at room temperature or 45 °C to see how formation affects life.
notes: Hosted on Battery Archive.

chemistry_evidence.note: Battery Archive study summary: graphite negative and NMC positive electrodes.

name: RWTH 48-Cell Cycle Ageing Dataset (Sanyo/Panasonic UR18650E)
scale: 48 identical cells · same profile and conditions
description: Forty-eight cells of one type aged with the same cycling profile, with a begin-of-life test and regular reference tests. Shows cell-to-cell spread under identical use; one of the sets bundled in BatteryML and BatteryLife.
notes: Licence is described in the Content.pdf file inside the record.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record: carbon anode and NMC cathode.

name: Battery and Heating Data in Real Driving Cycles (BMW i3)
scale: 72 real trips · one BMW i3 (60 Ah)
description: Logged drives of a BMW i3 with battery voltage, current, temperature and state of charge alongside vehicle speed, weather and cabin-heating data. Used for range, thermal and heating-strategy studies.
notes: Open access on IEEE DataPort; downloading needs a free IEEE account.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the data page gives the 60 Ah capacity but not the chemistry.

name: Argonne CAMP Cycle-Life Dataset (2023 release)
scale: About 300 cells · six cathode chemistries (per Argonne)
description: Cycle-life tests of cells made at Argonne's Cell Analysis, Modeling and Prototyping facility, all with graphite anodes and charged below 1C, stored in HDF5 with raw signals and per-cycle summaries. Includes cells that failed the study's acceptance criteria.
notes: Hosted on the Materials Data Facility; files use Argonne's Battery Data Toolkit format.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record title: 'Dataset of NMC battery Tests from CAMP'. Argonne says the study covered six chemistries; the others are not named on the record.

name: UL–Purdue Degradation-Safety Dataset (UL-PUR)
source: UL Research Institutes and Purdue University
scale: 21 cylindrical cells, 14 pouch cells and modules · aged to 10–20% fade
description: Commercial NCA cells aged at room temperature in two voltage windows to set amounts of capacity fade, so that their later safety behaviour can be tied to ageing. Part III adds pouch cells and modules.
notes: Hosted on Battery Archive.

chemistry_evidence.note: Battery Archive study summary: graphite negative and NCA positive electrodes.

name: BatteryLife: Dataset and Benchmark for Battery Life Prediction
description: Harmonised collection of 13 public ageing datasets (CALCE, HNEI, MATR, UL-PUR, SNL, MICH, RWTH, HUST, Tongji, Stanford, XJTU, ISU-ILCC and others) plus new zinc-ion, sodium-ion and industrial CALB data, with a benchmark for predicting life from the first 100 cycles.
notes: MIT licence is for the code; processed data is on Hugging Face and Zenodo, and each raw dataset keeps its own terms.

chemistry_evidence.note: Paper covers Li-ion, zinc-ion and sodium-ion cells; the Li-ion cathodes come from the source datasets' own pages.

name: Battery Archive
source: Sandia National Laboratories (US DOE Office of Electricity)
scale: Studies from 8+ institutions · cycling and abuse tests
description: Public portal that hosts, plots and compares cell test data from several labs (CALCE, HNEI, ISU-ILCC, ORNL, Oxford, Sandia, UL-Purdue, Michigan) in one format. Useful as one entry point to many datasets listed here.
notes: No licence stated on the site. Full CSV files for a study are sent on request by email.

chemistry_evidence.note: Study summaries list LCO, LFP, LMO, NCA and NMC cells across the hosted studies.

name: Mechanically Induced Thermal Runaway Dataset (ORNL & Sandia)
source: Oak Ridge and Sandia National Laboratories
scale: Over 100 indentation tests · several chemistries and states of charge
description: Cells pushed into internal short circuit by single-side indentation, with voltage, load, indenter travel and temperature recorded over time, and a 0–100 severity score for each test.
notes: Licence field is blank on the data page.

chemistry_evidence.note: The data record lists chemistry as a recorded field without values; Battery Archive's summary of the same tests lists NMC, LCO, LFP and LMO-based blends.

name: VITO Lifecycle Ageing Tests on Ni-Rich 18650 Cells
description: Commercial 18650 cells cycled at 25 °C and 45 °C with different charge and discharge rates in a 10–90% state-of-charge window, plus driving-profile ageing, with periodic reference tests.
notes: No journal paper; details are in EVERLASTING project deliverable D2.3.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record: nickel-rich positive and silicon/graphite negative electrodes, without saying whether NMC or NCA.

name: VITO Battery Module Ageing with Driving Profile
description: Two 16-cell modules built from the same Ni-rich 18650 cells as the VITO cell-level set, aged with an adapted real-world driving profile; per-cell voltages and temperatures included.
notes: Cell temperature columns carry a 30 °C offset (see record). Companion to the VITO cell-level ageing data.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record: Ni-rich cathode and silicon/graphite anode, without saying whether NMC or NCA.

name: LiionDB: Parameter Database for Li-ion Battery Models
source: University of Birmingham, Imperial College London and partners
scale: Parameters and state functions collected from the literature for physics-based (DFN) models
description: Searchable database of measured parameters and functions (diffusivities, conductivities, open-circuit potentials and more) reported in the literature for physics-based lithium-ion cell models, with the review that explains how each is measured.
notes: CC BY 4.0 applies to the review article.

chemistry_evidence.note: Literature parameter database covering many electrode materials, not test data from particular cells.

name: Battery Materials Database (auto-generated with ChemDataExtractor)
description: Text-mined database of reported battery-material properties (capacity, voltage, conductivity, Coulombic efficiency, energy) extracted automatically from the literature, for materials screening and data-driven discovery.

chemistry_evidence.note: Materials database extracted from papers; not measurements on particular cells.

name: Turnigy Graphene 5000 mAh 65C Li-ion Battery Data
scale: New 5 Ah high-power cell · drive cycles and pulses at 6 temperatures (−20 to 40 °C)
description: Pulse, constant-current and drive-cycle tests (UDDS, HWFET, LA92, US06 and mixed cycles) on a high-power pouch cell from −20 °C to 40 °C, from the same lab as the LG HG2 data.
notes: No paper or licence listed on the data page.

chemistry_evidence.note: Checked: the data record says lithium-ion only.

name: Graphite//LFP Synthetic Datasets for Diagnosis and Prognosis (HNEI)
scale: Over 700,000 voltage curves · about 130,000 duty cycles
description: Simulated voltage–capacity curves covering more than 5,000 degradation paths (loss of lithium and of active material) for a graphite/LFP cell, plus a companion set of simulated duty cycles, made with a mechanistic model to train diagnosis and prognosis methods.
notes: The duty-cycle set (doi:10.17632/6s6ph9n8zg.3) needs this voltage-curve set to work.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record title: graphite//LFP.

name: LG M50 Parameterisation Data (Chen et al.)
source: University of Warwick (WMG) and University of Birmingham
scale: 1 cell type · 35 model parameters · 3 cells at 4 C-rates
description: Measured parameter set for a physics-based model of the LG M50 21700 cell from teardown, GITT and impedance tests, with charge and discharge data at several C-rates for validation. The source of the widely used Chen2020 parameter set in PyBaMM.
notes: Released under a Creative Commons licence; the record does not say which one.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record: NMC 811 positive and graphite–SiOx negative electrodes.

name: Samsung INR21700-50E Second-Life Capacity and HPPC Tests
scale: 444 test samples · 143 cells with full charge/discharge tests
description: Cells taken from used micromobility packs (plus some new cells), presorted by state of health and tested at 25 °C with capacity tests and high-rate pulse (HPPC) tests at each 10% state of charge.
notes: About 15 GB. Linked to a 2024 IEEE ITEC conference paper.

chemistry_evidence.note: The Zenodo record says lithium-ion only; a separate Data in Brief article on the same Samsung INR21700-50E cell describes it as NCA.

name: Synthetic Blended-Electrode Datasets (HNEI)
description: Simulated voltage–capacity curves for cells with blended positive electrodes (LFP/LMO, NMC/LMO and NMC/NCA) against graphite, across many combinations of lithium and active-material loss, for testing diagnosis on blended cells.

chemistry_evidence.note: Data record: LFP/LMO, NMC/LMO and NCM/NCA blended electrodes against graphite.

name: Samsung INR18650-30Q Knee-Point Aging Dataset
scale: 60 Samsung INR18650-30Q cells · 9 ageing conditions · SOH 100% to ~60%
description: Experimental cycling of 60 high-power 3 Ah NCA/graphite–silicon cells under nine temperature, voltage and charge-rate conditions. Periodic reference performance tests track capacity/SOH and DC resistance through 80% SOH; further common-protocol cycling at 25 °C follows cells toward 60% SOH. Developed for studying accelerated degradation knee points and second-life assessment.
notes: Useful for knee-point diagnostics and candidate knee-onset research. Knee-onset cycle labels are not explicitly supplied; derive and validate them before prediction experiments. The ageing protocol changes after 80% SOH, and reference capacity is sampled periodically, so account for this before fitting knee trajectories.

chemistry_evidence.note: Mendeley Data v4 and the associated PNAS publication specify Samsung INR18650-30Q NCA/graphite–silicon cells.

name: Chalmers Synthetic NMC811 Cracking-Induced Knee Trajectories
source: Chalmers University of Technology — Zhang, Altaf & Wik
scale: 5 simulated NMC811 battery trajectories · 5 particle-cracking rates
description: Synthetic knee-forming degradation data generated using a PyBaMM Doyle–Fuller–Newman electrochemical model coupled with SEI growth and negative-electrode particle cracking. Five cracking multipliers (10–50 times standard) yield simulated capacity-fade paths; reference model is an LG Chem INR21700 M50 NMC811/graphite-SiOx cell.
notes: Directly relevant to studying knee formation, curvature-based knee-onset identification and simulated degradation mechanisms. Synthetic simulation, not experimental or in-vehicle measurements. The dataset page does not explicitly advertise ready-to-use per-cell knee-onset cycle labels; derive them consistently for benchmarking.

chemistry_evidence.note: Source states 5 synthetic NMC811/graphite-SiOx battery trajectories, modeled with DFN/PyBaMM and cracking-induced knees.

name: SNU Dynamic-Usage Battery RUL Dataset (130 Cells)
source: Seoul National University — Yong Jin Jeong
scale: 130 experimental cells in 3 cohorts (90 + 12 + 28) · charging protocols up to 1,000 cycles
description: Experimental cell cycling under Markov-sequence fast and slow charging profiles (3C and 0.5C), with controlled 1C discharge and 0.2C capacity checks approximately every 30 cycles. Two Sony VTC6 NCA/graphite–Si cohorts and one Samsung INR18650-25R blended NCA/NCM/graphite–Si cohort. The source provides cell-level cycling traces and protocol metadata.
notes: Candidate for retrospective knee-onset labeling and leakage-free BMS early-warning evaluation under randomized charging profiles. Source dataset targets RUL, not pre-labelled knee onset; confirm whether each cell exhibits a knee and handle no-knee/censored trajectories.

chemistry_evidence.note: Repository describes 90+12 NCA/Gr-Si Sony VTC6 and 28 mixed NCA+NCM/Gr-Si Samsung INR18650-25R cells.

name: SNU LG MJ1 Dynamic-Usage and Capacity-Retention Dataset
source: Seoul National University — Kim, An & Choi
scale: 81 LG Chem INR18650-MJ1 cells · NMC811/graphite–SiOx · periodic diagnostics
description: High-throughput experimental dynamic-usage cycling of 81 commercial NMC811/graphite–SiOx 3.5 Ah cells at 25 °C. The repository includes capacity-retention trajectories and SOC-dependent relaxation/voltage response diagnostics, with reference performance tests every 100 cycles.
notes: Capacity-retention trajectories may support knee-onset identification, but the source does not claim explicit knee-onset labels. Periodic 100-cycle diagnostics limit the temporal resolution of any label and must be accounted for in prediction error intervals.

chemistry_evidence.note: Source explicitly identifies 81 LG Chem INR18650-MJ1 NMC811/graphite–SiOx cells.

name: ICFormer Knee Detection: Two Real A123 LFP Cells
source: ICFormer authors — Nahuel Costa et al.
scale: 2 experimental A123 LFP cells plus related synthetic diagnosis/prognosis resources
description: The public ICFormer research repository documents two experimentally cycled A123 graphite/LFP cells (ANR26650M1a, 2.3 Ah; ANR26650M1b, 2.5 Ah) with accelerated-fade knees. It contains a data folder and accompanying reproducible notebooks and model code for incremental-capacity-based early knee detection.
notes: Small-scale real-cell knee demonstration rather than a population-scale generalization benchmark. The repository also refers to separate HNEI synthetic diagnosis and prognosis datasets already partly indexed in IonSense. No explicit independent dataset licence was found in the repository README; check individual files before redistribution. Inspect notebooks for reference knee-event labels.

chemistry_evidence.note: Authors' README explicitly identifies real A123 graphite/LFP cells ANR26650M1a and ANR26650M1b and experimental knee cases.
